title: A model your agent sets up
description: Your agent defines your records and fields. Semantius creates the tables, the fields and who may access them in one step.

title: Works with your agent
description: Your agent connects directly and works in the same records, rules and permissions as your team.

title: A login for every agent
description: Give your agent a login, not the keys to everything. Each agent works under its own login and can only do what its role allows.

title: Start from a template
description: Ready-made starting points by department and industry, so your agent doesn't start from a blank page.

title: Linked records
description: Clients, jobs, orders and approvals are linked records, so a job can't point to a customer that doesn't exist.

title: Records that belong together
description: Order lines belong to their order and checklist items to their job, so neither exists on its own.

title: Many-to-many links
description: Several people on one project, and one person on many projects.

title: Readable record numbers
description: Orders numbered SO-1042 instead of a long code, easy to read out over the phone.

title: Rich field types
description: Email addresses, links, durations, ratings, colors, rich text and more, each in its own format.

title: Statuses in color
description: Statuses and categories with their own labels, colors and icons, readable at a glance.

title: Full-text search
description: Full-text search on each type of record, such as finding a job by its address or title.

title: Bring your data with you
description: Your agent imports what you have today, for example from CSV files. There are no built-in connectors to other tools.

title: Rules checked on every change
description: Your rules are checked on every change, from the app, the API or any agent's own login, where you've defined them. A rule can compare the old value with the new one.

title: Required and unique values
description: Required fields, default values and unique values, such as no two assets with the same tag, enforced by the database.

title: Values worked out for you
description: Values such as a line total, quantity times price, are computed by the database on every change, instead of by your agent.

title: Totals that keep up
description: Sums, counts, averages, minimums and maximums over related records, such as an order total, updated with every change.

title: Roles and permissions
description: Each person and each agent gets a role, and the role decides what they can see and change.

title: Each person sees only their part
description: A rule you define decides which records each person sees, such as a technician's own jobs or an account manager's own clients. It's checked in the database for every app, API and agent login.

title: Every change on record
description: Every change is on record: who made it, person or agent, and when, with the values before and after. You switch it on per record type.

title: Approvals that hold
description: Quotes, purchase requests and client sign-offs move only through the steps you set, and only the right person can move them on. Nobody approves their own request, and the record shows who approved it and when.

title: A ready-made app for your team
description: Screens come from the model, not hand-coded per table. Your team works in the browser on phones, tablets and laptops, with nothing to install.

title: Sign in with Google or Microsoft
description: In the cloud, people sign in with their Google or Microsoft 365 account. Self-hosted, you connect your own Microsoft Entra ID or any identity provider that has a JWKS endpoint.

title: Forms that adapt
description: A rule hides a field, makes it required or makes it read-only, such as a reason that's required when a job is canceled.

title: Yours to keep
description: You keep the whole system: the data, the rules, the permissions and the app. Export it at any time, or run all of it yourself with the Docker Compose or Dokploy template.
